State/respondent nos.1 to 4.
Mr. Shashank Upadhyay, Advocate for 
respondent no.5.
In all these writ petitions, the relief sought is 
similar. However, prayer of WPSS No.1390 of 2026 is 
being quoted hereinbelow:-
“(i) To issue a suitable writ order or direction in the 
nature of certiorari quashing the impugned order dated 
21.4.2026 passed by the Respondent no. 4 (Annexure No. 
15 Page No.123 to Page No.124 of the writ petition)
whereby the appointment letter dated 17.2.2026 of the 
petitioner provisionally appointing him on the post of 
Assistant Teacher in Govt. Primary School Taila Jakholi 
Rudraprayag District Rudraprayag since the 10.12.2021 i.e. 
the date of issuance of appointment letters has been 
cancelled.
(ii) A suitable writ order or direction in the nature of 
mandamus commanding the respondent to restore the 
appointment letter dated 17.02.2026 of the petitioner 
provisionally appointing him on the post of Assistant 
Teacher in Govt. Primary School Taila Jakholi Rudraprayag 
District Rudraprayag since the 10.12.2021 i.e. the date of 
issuance of appointment letters.”
Learned counsel for the respondents prays for and 
is granted six weeks’ time to file counter affidavit.
List thereafter along with connected matters.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
08.06.2026
